name: kentra-rpir
description: Runs one change (feature, bug or chore) through plan, implement and review. One planning session writes the spec and a coarse milestoned-plan-dag plan, with premises researched in the background by a session research pool and one joint review of spec and plan. Opus milestone leads brief fresh Sonnet implementers in parallel worktrees, a fresh verifier checks each milestone, and a retro reads the session transcripts and records its findings in two registries. The improve and improve-plugin skills rank those findings and carry out the ones the user accepts, and an optional audit skill runs on each repository after implement.
